text:
Anika R: Quick heads-up — nightly KB scan flagged ~87 broken links across /kb and /runtime-guide. Dropping the gist of findings, need owners to claim anything you touched in the last 6mo.

docs-bot: scan summary (run id: 2026-03-18-03) — 87 broken link alerts. top paths: /kb/setup/legacy-config.md -> 404, /runtime/compile-kernels.md -> 404, /kb/images/arch-diagram.png -> 403. Full CSV + file list: https://internal.gists/scan/3054321000

Chris L: I can take /runtime/compile-kernels.md — will open a redirect + doc tweak PR.

Anika R: awesome, @Chris L please add a short frontmatter note with old_url and a one-line changelog so we can track regressions. :thumbsup:

Maya: I'm happy to take the /kb/setup cluster. The CSV has owner blank for most — is there a quick way to filter by last-modified? I can triage if we can get that column.

Anika R: CSV includes last_modified but our extractor drops it in the UI. use the gist CSV raw: there's a `last_modified` column. If you want a tiny helper: `awk -F, '$5 > "2025-09-01" { print $1 }' broken_links.csv` to list recent ones.

Maya: nice, thanks. claiming: Maya for kb/setup/*

Leo: small note — several docs reference s3://cdn.redwood-inference/... which now returns 403 after the bucket policy change. Those images need rehosting on assets.redwood-inference.com or else replaced with svg fallbacks.

SamJ: I can handle the image rehost for the three heaviest pages. Will open a PR for s3 -> assets path rewrite and add a placeholder where the asset is in the localized folders.

Anika R: quick patch pattern if helpful (run locally on a branch):
```bash
# preview affected files
grep -R "s3://cdn.redwood-inference" content/kb/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u
# sed replace (preview with -n first)
sed -n '1,20p' content/kb/some-file.md
python scripts/rewrite_asset_links.py --from s3://cdn.redwood-inference --to https://assets.redwood-inference.com
```

Chris L: PR #4527 opened — adds a redirect and updates the anchor in runtime/compile-kernels.md. @Anika R PTAL when you have 5 min.

Anika R: pulling it now. Quick note — add `old_url:` frontmatter so the redirect audit picks it up automatically.

Chris L: added frontmatter and a changelog entry. PR updated.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs-sweep ticket created #DOCS-814. Auto-assign will run at 18:00 UTC for any remaining unclaimed items.

SamJ: PR opened for images: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4532 — replaces three S3-hosted images, tests pass in CI.

Maya: claimed: Maya (kb/setup/*) — will do basic content sanity check + small copy edits before merge.

Anika R: for the remaining unknown files please put a one-liner in the CSV gist like `claim: <handle>` so I can update the sweep board and reduce noise. If you can't edit the gist, drop your handle here and I'll add it.

Chris L: PR #4527 merged. :tada:

docs-bot: post-merge update: Closed 12 broken-link alerts after merges. Remaining alerts: 63 (see gist).

Anika R: thanks everyone. If blocked on infra/CDN perms ping @infra-team; otherwise drop PR links here and I’ll do a final pass. Planning to run a follow-up scan tomorrow morning and auto-close anything patched.

SamJ: merged my image PR as well.

Leo: thanks — rehosted images look good in staging.

Anika R: great wrap. I’ll update DOCS-814 with owners and close the loop after tomorrow's scan.
